g.text: Panel: J1 jack in; J2, J3 pots (1 CCW=GND, 2 wiper, 3 CW=buffered input); J4, J5 jack out (1 tip, 2 GND).

g.text: Unity at full level, 0 V fully down; DC-coupled (CV and audio). IN_MULT: an on-board signal summed with the jack at unity.
